note: Six committer identities (plan.md 6.2.1). git records no session, so the committer names which of the six made a commit and the author stays the person. Read by check 41 at every commit, which judges each commit against the registry its parent held. Until 2026-11-04 this file held one row per session, 135 in all; on branch closed-loop-validation the person replaced that with one row per agent plus two for the person's side: "다섯 이름으로 진행" (go with five names), then, told that a root session committing under the person's name could also commit an approval, "여섯 개로" (make it six). The rows before this commit stay readable in history and still judge the commits made under them.
boundaries: owns holds boundary names as check 41 derives them from the path, using the same table check 35 counts: design, microscope_agent (which holds microscope_runtime/ too), simulation_agent, librarian_agent and bridge (which holds every <agent>/inbox/). An agent's CLAUDE.md, README.md, .claude/ and tasks/ are design's, and so is all of contracts/.
addresses: seat.invalid is reserved by RFC 2606 and can never route. A seat identity is a label, not a mailbox.
enforced_from_note: The commit that turned the session boundary from a convention into a gate. Checks 35 and 41 report rather than fail for anything at or before it. Two independent reasons, both checked on 2026-09-17: before f971c40 the boundary was written in 6.2 but nothing refused a crossing, and every commit in that stretch is the person's own -- who owns every boundary anyway (see the human seat). Exactly three commits are affected (0ea116e, e6a87f1, 72d17fc), all of them contracts/ and librarian_agent/ together while one design seat held both and kb/ was a hand-curated store.
persons_files: approvals/ and envelope/safety.json in microscope_agent/, microscope_runtime/ and simulation_agent/ are committed by human alone, whatever another row owns (check 41, PERSONS_FILES). That is why design is a row of its own: a session at the repository root commits as design, so the person's name stays the one that signs.

seats.note: The microscope agent and its run engine: microscope_agent/ and microscope_runtime/, except the files design owns and the person's own files. Every microscope session commits under this name.
The simulation agent: simulation_agent/, except the files design owns and the person's own files.
The librarian: librarian_agent/, the store and its server, except the files design owns.

The courier: bridge/ and the inboxes it delivers into, <agent>/inbox/<thread>/. Only this name commits a delivery, so an agent cannot write its own inbox. The name was closed once, in the per-session registry, and is reopened here as the one bridge identity.

The repository's own files: plan.md, the instruction files, contracts/ (this registry included), docs/, the root configuration, and each agent's CLAUDE.md, README.md, .claude/ and tasks/. A session at the repository root commits under this name. It is not the person and cannot commit an approval or a safety limit.

The person, and only the person: the one identity that may commit approvals/ and envelope/safety.json. No session commits under it unless the person says so for that commit. It is opt-in rather than the git default, so a commit nobody named is reported and not silently the person's. It also owns `console`, the boundary of the removed console, so that the commit deleting it and the history before it have an owner; nothing lives there now.
